notes.content:
[u][b]Patch Notes[/b][/u]

- Resolution Setting: Added to the main menu settings and game mode pause screen.

- Steering Avoidance: Implemented for select enemies, reducing the chance of enemies appearing next to you through walls.

- Restart Animation: Increased the speed of the restart animation for smoother gameplay flow.

- Application and Main Menu Cleanup: Removed unnecessary elements and placeholder features not ready for the main build.

- Difficulty Selection: Added to allow players to customize their gameplay experience.

[u][b]To Do[/b][/u]

- Fix Intermittent Pause Enlargement Issue: Address the occasional issue where the pause screen enlarges unexpectedly.

- Final Boss Death Optimization: Improve performance and gameplay flow during the final boss's defeat sequence.

- Weapon Information: Add detailed information about available weapons in the game.

- Rework Different Modes: Review and refine descriptions and mechanics for different game modes.

notes.title: Update 2.0.0 “The Feedback Update"
notes.content:
In an attempt to share my project with as many people as possible I did my best with the tools I had to localize the game in 12 languages. I however do not speak 12 languages... So I ask you to have sympathy for my translations as they are an attempt to communicate with people from all over the world. I beg you to send me any changes or errors you might find, my goal is to make this game as good as possible.

All of the updates in this are from feedback given from you, so I would like to thank everyone who helped by giving feedback or playing! Thank you for helping make my game better!
